zh.heading: 一呼 Yihu：你自己的工作台，iPhone 上的语音入口。
zh.answer: 一呼（Yihu）把 iPhone 语音变成你已有工作台的草稿：识别在手机完成，最终文字填入当前草稿，不替你发送。App Store 商店版为 0.1.0，需 iOS 18+；工作台地址与账号由你提供。

faqs.question: 一呼更适合谁？
faqs.answer: 已有 Agent 网页工作台、希望在 iPhone 上少打字接续工作的人。如果只想得到一份录文，独立转录工具可能更省配置。

faqs.question: 一呼已经上架 App Store 了吗？
faqs.answer: 已上架，当前公开商店版为 0.1.0，App ID 6819057500，需 iOS 18+。已核美区页面，地区供应以商店显示为准；从商店安装不要求 Mac 或自行签名。源码开发者另按构建指南操作，不能把后续源码合入当成商店已更新。

faqs.question: 需要一开始就下载语音模型吗？
faqs.answer: 语音模型由你选择时再下载。商店版 0.1.0 说明的模型约 950 MB，与 App 安装包分开；先了解下载、存储和设备条件，再启用语音，不把未下载模型的状态说成语音已可用。

faqs.question: 网页预览会录我的声音吗？
faqs.answer: 预览使用示例材料，无需麦克风或蓝牙权限。它帮助理解流程；实际录音和工作台体验在 iPhone App 与所选服务中完成。

faqs.question: 草稿什么时候发送？
faqs.answer: 一呼填入文字时不会按下发送。网页工作台仍可能保存或同步草稿，私密材料交接前请了解所选服务的数据设置。

faqs.question: 录音之后就有会议纪要了吗？
faqs.answer: 以下为源码与工作流说明，当前商店版支持范围请核对实际版本。一呼保存本地录音并分段转写。你可交给所选工作台或工具整理，再对照原文确认人名、数字和待办负责人。

faqs.question: 商机简报从哪里来？
faqs.answer: 以下为源码与工作流说明，当前商店版支持范围请核对实际版本。来自你现有工作流准备的 JSON 导出或兼容数据源。一呼负责呈现事项，客户数据与询盘资料由你提供。

en.heading: Yihu: voice for the workspace you already use.
en.answer: Yihu is an iPhone voice companion for your existing workspace. Speech recognition runs on your phone, and the final transcript goes into the current draft without pressing Send. The App Store edition is 0.1.0 for iOS 18+; bring your own workspace address and account.
en.caption: Start with voice drafts; explore the task guides

faqs.question: Who is Yihu for?
faqs.answer: People who already use an Agent web workspace and want to continue by voice on iPhone. If you only need a transcript, a standalone recording tool may be simpler.

faqs.question: Can I install it from the App Store?
faqs.answer: Yes. The public store edition is 0.1.0, App ID 6819057500, for iOS 18+. The US listing is verified; availability follows your storefront. Store installation does not require a Mac or your own signing. Source developers follow separate build instructions; a source merge is not a store update.

faqs.question: Do I have to download a speech model immediately?
faqs.answer: You choose when to download the optional speech model. Store edition 0.1.0 describes about 950 MB, separate from the app installation. Check download, storage and device requirements before using speech; a missing model does not mean speech is ready.

faqs.question: Does this preview use my microphone?
faqs.answer: The preview uses sample material and runs without microphone or Bluetooth permission. It illustrates a workflow; the iPhone app and your chosen service provide the actual recording and workspace experience.

faqs.question: When does a draft get sent?
faqs.answer: Yihu inserts reviewed text without pressing Send. Your web workspace may save or sync drafts, so review its data settings before handing over private material.

faqs.question: Will it write finished meeting minutes for me?
faqs.answer: This describes source and workflow capabilities; check your installed store version for availability. Yihu keeps local audio and segmented transcription. Choose a workspace or tool to organize it, then check names, numbers and action owners against the original.

faqs.question: Where does the sales brief come from?
faqs.answer: This describes source and workflow capabilities; check your installed store version for availability. You supply a JSON export or compatible feed from your existing workflow. Yihu displays your tasks; it does not supply a customer database or automatically collect inquiries.
